mapper.select: SELECT id, map_id, place_id, created_by, created_at FROM map_place WHERE map_id = #{mapId} AND place_id = #{placeId} LIMIT 1
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM map_place WHERE map_id = #{mapId} AND place_id = #{placeId}
